required_fields: Clinical phenotypes reported in affected individuals with PLAA variants (OMIM #617527)
Numerator and denominator counts per cohort for each reported phenotype (not percentage alone)
Phenotype wording as stated in the source paper plus standard HPO term if identifiable
Source citation (PMID or DOI) and cohort identification attached to every reported phenotype frequency
Most discriminating findings (present in most affected individuals but uncommon in disorders usually confused with this condition)
Disorders typically confused with this condition and confidence level of the clinical distinction
Findings looked for and found absent in affected individuals (features arguing against the diagnosis)
Analysis of whether the phenotype differs by variant type, variant position, age, or sex
Any findings reported by one paper and explicitly contradicted by another
